promise: Achieve net zero across BlackRock by 2050 or sooner and launch investment products aligned to a net-zero pathway
description: In his January 2021 annual letter to CEOs and clients, Fink committed BlackRock to supporting a net-zero economy by 2050 or sooner, saying the firm would use its investment weight to press companies to cut carbon emissions and would introduce products with explicit temperature-alignment goals.
evidence: Commitment made in the 2021 annual letter to CEOs
BlackRock continued to hold major fossil-fuel assets, making full achievement uncertain as of 2026
